attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: individual Palari V2 character study

Primary request: Create one original Palari. Palari means Personal Artificial Intelligence. A Palari is a small crafted ceramic vessel whose single colored interior reveals its unique intelligence. This character belongs to a coherent species, not a human, conventional robot, toy wearing clothes, or household vessel.

Selected design:
- identity: fork-crown porcelain column with a long coral channel and one tracing arm
- silhouette: tall slender column with a subtly flared stable base
- crown: restrained split-petal crown with smooth finished edges
- opening: one long narrow recessed channel
- pose: one arm resting along the opening and the other close to the body
- expression: gently amused, conveyed only through calm eye posture, with no mouth
- exterior material: soft cool-neutral off-white porcelain, never pure digital white
- characteristic color: muted deep coral, visually anchored to #B94F48

Family invariants:
- one complete isolated figure with a stable continuous ceramic base
- tactile fine stoneware exterior with matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture
- exactly one characteristic hue, limited to the recessed inner intelligence, iris accents, and Palari seed mark
- one dominant architecturally intentional opening and no additional unrelated openings
- exactly two calm half-lidded inset eyes with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, coral iris accents, and tiny catchlights
- exactly two curved tubular ceramic arms ending in perfectly smooth seamless rounded tips with no hand anatomy
- no conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, or visible human anatomy
- exact Palari seed mark on the lower body: four larger circular coral apertures at the corners of a compact vertical rectangle with two smaller coral apertures centered vertically between them; exactly six apertures total, not a grille
- clean intact ceramic with smooth deliberately finished edges

Scene: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor.
Composition: eye-level three-quarter product portrait with minimal lens distortion; square composition, full figure and full base visible, centered, occupying about 76 percent of image height.
Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper left with a gentle contact shadow. Preserve readable ceramic form and inner depth without neon glow.

Avoid: simple horizontal bowl or cup rim, fingers, thumbs, palms, fingernails, realistic hands, conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, human skin, hair, clothing, jewelry, demographic costume shorthand, multiple characteristic colors, rainbow effects, neon glow, robot joints, screens, wires, exposed machinery, appliance details, random holes, more than one dominant opening, cracks, chips, broken rims, dirt, antique distressing, cups, mugs, vases, planters, lamps, speakers, household appliances, generic mascot smiles, chibi proportions, horror, vacant doll eyes, a circular aperture surrounding the face, text, labels, numbers, logos, watermarks.
attempts.review: Selected as the only source attempt. The column, fork crown, channel, two eyes, two fingerless arms, legless base, material, and single hue are clear, but the seed contains seven apertures rather than six.

grammarReview.seedGeometry: four larger corner apertures plus three smaller horizontal-center apertures
notes: The selected candidate visibly honors the column, split-petal crown, narrow coral channel, tracing-arm pose, porcelain material, and coral characteristic hue.
It fails the automatic seed rejection rule because a third small center aperture makes seven total.
This is a review candidate and is not production registered.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one square Palari IP mascot logo candidate derived from Image 1
Input image: Image 1 is identity reference only. Preserve its fork-crown column silhouette, long coral channel, two calm eyes, one long resting arm and one arm tracing the channel, stable legless base, and small six-aperture seed. Do not preserve its studio scene, realistic ceramic material, lighting, shadows, or camera depth.

Create one highly simplified logo first and character second.
Subject: the source Palari reduced to one tall rounded continuous ivory shell silhouette with a blunt two-lobed fork crown, one continuous long coral recessed channel, exactly two compact calm eye marks, and exactly two thick rounded arm forms. The shell/aperture silhouette must be the primary identity; keep the six-aperture Palari seed as a tiny secondary family detail near the lower body: four larger coral dots at rectangle corners plus two visibly smaller coral dots centered vertically, exactly six.

Composition: upright, emerging from and intentionally cropped only at the lower-left canvas corner; fill 75–85% of the square; never crop crown, eyes, opening, arms, or seed.
Complexity: 6–10 broad rounded structural forms; the six tiny seed cutouts are an explicit identity exception. Readable as a distinct black silhouette and recognizable at 32 × 32.

Color count: exactly three semantic colors total: warm ivory #E9E6DF for every shell and arm region, muted deep coral #B94F48 for the single inner channel plus eye marks and tiny seed, and deep navy #172333 only for the fully opaque edge-to-edge background. No other hue, gray, white, or black. Keep coral in one dominant continuous inner region; the tiny eye/seed reuses are required identity marks.
Style: flat-first vector-friendly geometry with extremely subtle continuous-gradient micro-volume only. One uninterrupted low-frequency same-family diffuse gradient within each large ivory/coral region, sharing an upper-left-to-lower-right light direction, spanning at least half each form; total lightness variation <= 0.08. Nearly flat at 32 px.

Forbid: illustration, scene, alcove, floor, texture, ceramic realism, clay, plastic, toy render, gloss, bevel, extrusion, cast shadow, contact shadow, rim light, discrete highlight patches, inner shadow blobs, hard shading bands, outlines, thin lines, sharp crown points, extra apertures, extra arms, hands, fingers, legs, feet, mouth, eyebrows, nostrils, text, watermark, border, frame, vignette, gradient background, transparency, rounded canvas corners, App icon mask.
attempts.review: Rejected: the seed contains seven circles, the background visibly vignettes, and the mark is centered instead of emerging from the lower-left.
